prompt: Add a CSV export to the customer list: a service that builds the CSV from the customers and a "Download CSV" button in the customer list.
Create a reusable loading spinner and show it in the order list while the orders are loading.
Add an HTTP interceptor that sets an X-Correlation-Id header (a new UUID per request) and register it in the app.

Show the total amount of each order in the order list, formatted as euros. Reuse what the app already has where possible.
